name: Dream Silk
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: individual material illustration for the Avarenne novel encyclopedia. Style: refined semi-realistic painted novel art, exquisite tactile detail and believable natural material behaviour, late industrial craft atmosphere. Landscape 3:2. One coherent close-up scene of this ONE material, with raw or worked examples of that same material only where requested; not a composite board of different materials. Use light and background suited to this specific material so its texture, silhouette and colour are immediately legible. No people, no readable letters or numerals, no labels, logo, watermark, card frame or infographic. Do not add supernatural effects to ordinary material. No extra tools or props that could be mistaken for a different catalogue specimen.
